BiblicalUsage: Once in each genealogy, a son of Joktan: Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah. The name is a link in the table of nations, one of the thirteen sons whose families spread across the south, and the link is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in a genealogy carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the spread of the nations after the flood, that the sons of Joktan are counted even though their stories are not told.
